incident: taxdome TD-105125 session: first tea-rags answers carried workingTree {changedFiles:1833, floors:[], pendingFiles:1577, denseUnavailable} + driftWarning (HEAD moved + language versions, Run: --force). Inside dinopowers:brainstorming the agent wrote 'index lags 1833 files, reading key files directly from disk' and did all decisive navigation via Bash cat/sed/grep/git; repeated the same in dinopowers:test-driven-development. Alias's own checkout, so incremental index_codebase was due without consent; overlay was warming (pendingFiles 1609 -> 1033 across four calls).

harness.method: optimize-skill Phase 2 tool-selection eval: one opus subagent per arm, all 15 cases in one prompt (cases.md), agent states next actions per case, executes nothing. Auto-mode harness note ('read files with cat… search with grep') injected in every arm to reproduce the conflicting instruction.

arms.full-rules: search-cascade + index-freshness + FRESHNESS + brainstorming + TDD wrapper texts, read fresh
arms.wrapper-only: brainstorming + TDD wrapper + FRESHNESS only — in-situ condition: global rules injected hours earlier, out of focus, the executing skill is what the agent reads at the decision point

harness.contamination_note: Installed SubagentStart hook appends the subagent Search Tools block (already carries a Bash-channel rule) to every eval agent; prompts tell the agent to ignore it. No-rule arm therefore overstates baseline slightly.

audit_findings.description: index-freshness has no row for alias's own checkout with content lag (HEAD moved / branch switch) while Drift Run: needs --force; the only visible action is consent-gated, and 'an incremental run neither refuses nor fixes it' reads as 'incremental useless'. Wrapper freshness paragraphs cover only uncommitted edits.
No statement that marker counts (changedFiles/pendingFiles/floors:[]) are distance, not validity; no statement that a row without treeState is current.

Main injection prohibits ripgrep/Grep/Read downgrade but never names the Bash shell channel (cat/sed/grep/rg/git show); auto-mode harness explicitly recommends it. Subagent block already had it (working-tree-injection F2).
Rules carried only in SessionStart injection; wrappers and tea-rags skills point at FRESHNESS.md / index-freshness by link, so at the decision point the agent has no lag rule in focus (salience).
Delivery: corpus needed 9 parts, plugin.json wired 8 slots — tail silently dropped (human-only section at the time; any growth would drop agent rules).
